faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Is the MoneFin app really 100% free?
faq.a1: Yes! MoneFin can be used 100% free with no hidden fees, no separate Pro version, and no limit on the number of transactions.
faq.q2: Is my financial data safe in MoneFin?
faq.a2: Your security and privacy is our top priority. We use industry-standard data encryption (HTTPS & Bearer Token) and never sell your financial data to third parties.
faq.q3: Can I lock the app so others can't open it?
faq.a3: Of course. MoneFin supports secure login authentication and email OTP code verification for double protection.
faq.q4: Can I export financial reports to Excel or PDF format?
faq.a4: Yes! You can export monthly financial report summaries directly from the Reports page in both PDF and Excel spreadsheet formats.

features.t1_title: Automated Salary Allocation with 50/30/20 Ideal Method
features.t1_desc: Simply enter your estimated monthly salary, MoneFin automatically divides it into three main pillars: Essential Needs (50%), Wants (30%), and Savings/Investments (20%).
features.t1_cat1_desc: Food, bills, rent, electricity, and routine expenses
features.t1_cat3_desc: Emergency funds, mutual funds, gold, and dreams
features.t2_title: Monitor Bank Accounts & E-Wallets in One View
features.t2_desc: No need to open 5 different banking apps every night. MoneFin aggregates your BCA, Mandiri, BRI, GoPay, OVO, ShopeePay to cash balances into one clean summary.
features.t3_title: AI Advisor Guiding Every Financial Decision
features.t3_desc: MoneFin analyzes your spending trends and provides proactive advice if there are wasteful spikes in food, transport, or unused subscription categories.
features.t3_a1_desc: Spending in the "Coffee & Dine Out" category increased by 24%. By limiting transactions to 3x a week, you can allocate an extra Rp 450,000 to your Emergency Fund.
features.t3_a2_desc: With savings of Rp 2,500,000/month, the emergency fund target of Rp 45,000,000 will be reached in 16 months.
features.t4_desc: Set a target for when you want to pay off a house down payment, buy a new laptop, or vacation costs. MoneFin will track your daily progress with an interactive percentage indicator.
